PART I
Item 1. Business
Northwind Outdoor Co. (the “Company”) designs hiking footwear and technical apparel. The Company sells through 42 retail stores and its online shop.
The Company’s fiscal year ends on December 31. Fiscal 2025 had 52 weeks.
Item 1A.    Risk Factors
The Company depends on a single supplier located in Portugal for most of its footwear. See Item 7 of this Form 10-K for a discussion of how supply disruptions affected results in 2025, including the effect on gross margin.
Unseasonable weather can reduce demand for insulated products.
